en: A .benv naming whichever of the two were written. It holds no pixels, so it needs at least one of them.
The image-based lighting: the specular and diffuse convolutions of the same radiance. Uncheck it to import only the backdrop.
The backdrop: one radiance cube map, projected from the source.
Names the copied source and the environment document.

Subfolder of Authored/EnvSources/ for the copy of the file being imported, and the .bimport beside it. Together they are what re-produces this environment in a checkout that does not carry the derived files.
